issues: Seven of the 1,127 draw keys no longer exist: identity pass 3 merged them after Gate 1b drew the samples. The 803 draw measures 798 pages, the 324 draw 322, and the 324 draw's like-for-like set 251 rather than 252. Six of the seven old slugs answer 308 to their merged parent (danaparoid-sodium, enoxaparin-sodium, teriparatide-acetate, ardeparin-sodium, porfimer-sodium, tesamorelin-acetate) and inclisiran answers 200 under a new key, so no indexed URL was orphaned.

scripts/corpus-20k/overlap/measure.py --sample truncates a page key at its first comma (load_sample splits on ','), so COMBO keys are silently dropped: a first pass lost 10 of 798, 7 of 604, 3 of 636. Worked around by writing one NDJSON per set, the way Gate 2 did; the scorer was not edited mid-measurement. It should be fixed before the next measurement run.

The live indexed figures reproduce the pre-deploy Gate 2 v2 recheck to six decimal places (all-pairs positional 0.195831, size-matched 0.188161, lexical 0.368746 / 0.352953, shared-word share 0.430757 / 0.369318). Mean and max differ in the fifth decimal, so one or two pages differ slightly; the extracted visible text of the deployed pages is otherwise the same text Gate 2 measured on the isolated build.
Crawl text-to-HTML on the same 636 pages fell from 0.10898 pre-deploy to 0.10649 live: the JSON-LD block added in Phase 5d adds bytes and no visible text. Still well above the 8.3 % baseline.

The all-pairs positional p90 on the indexed set is 0.577 and 277 of 636 pages sit above the 0.20 median target. R3 binds the median; the tail is concentrated in the pages that share a display name or a target lineage, as Gate 2 recorded.
Production suppressed is 19,268 of 28,832 pages. data/corpus-20k/suppression/summary.json records 19,335 of 28,943; that file predates identity pass 3 and the two are not the same population.

page_seeds holds no row for seed 1 (bioavailability gap) or seed 11 (animal-only ceiling) anywhere in production, and no seed 13 row on any indexable page. Seed 7 (sex-specific divergence) still has 36 stored rows after the Phase 5a decision to discard it, but it renders nothing: no question string on production asks whether a compound acted differently in male and female animals (0 of 60,667). The stored rows are bookkeeping, not page content.
Tier 2 contributes 26 of the 636 indexed pages; the 7-10 present-field promotion band recorded in Phase 5a has not been exercised.

verdict.statement: Every binding threshold is met on the live site: R3 uniqueness at the indexed set, R7 question repetition, R6 Tier 3 noindex and sitemap exclusion, R13 throughput floor.
